highlights: Positions are grouped by coin. One card per asset shows Total PnL, the fixed APR you lock, capital and lifetime cost, with a PnL waterfall that foots to the cent
Each exchange is a funding bundle: its perp with every Boros leg hedging it, the blended fixed APR, the floating rate now, settlements, fees and trade PnL. Expand it to see the legs
Close any leg from its row, or both legs of a pair, with one size box and a hold to confirm. A missing or short leg says so and arms the order ticket
Set a start date per asset and exclude legs or slices from the farm. Every number follows
The 2-step wizard and the Boros ticket are redesigned: form on the left, live quote on the right, slippage as distance from mid
The whole app wears the Boros look, with better contrast and keyboard access
